content.title: BLS isn't publishing Oct. jobs report, Kraken files for US IPO
content.description:

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Clio Completes $1B vLex Acquisition, Secures $500M At $5B Valuation In Largest Legal Tech Deal
content.summary: Legal technology company Clio announced on Nov. 10 that it has closed what it calls one of the industry’s most significant and largest transactions to date. The firm closed its $1 billion purchase of vLex while raising $500 million in a Series G round that valued the company at $5 billion. New Enterprise Associates led the Series G investment, joined by existing backers Technology Crossover Ventures, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Sixth Street Growth, and JMI Equity. content.title: Blue Owl Scraps Merger of Private Credit Funds After Selloff
content.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is calling off a merger of two of its private-credit funds after scrutiny over potential investor losses sent its shares tumbling. The firm terminated the deal between Blue Owl Capital Corp. and Blue Owl Capital Corp. II, citing current market conditions, and will re-evaluate its alternatives. Blue Owl's shares erased early gains on Wednesday in New York, on track for the lowest closing level since December 2023. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joined Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec on 'Bloomberg Businessweek Daily' to break it all down.

content.title: Financial Stocks Send Warning, Threaten to Tumble Below Support
content.summary: Weakness in the sector, driven by a combination of credit problems and traders trimming bets on interest rate cuts from the Federal Reserve, threatens to take out one of the pillars of the market’s hoped-for-advance through the end of the year.  The KBW Bank Index has fallen 4.5% over the last five trading sessions, badly underperforming the S&P 500 Index’s 2.9% drop over the same period, despite Tuesday’s 1.1% bounce.  “If the bank stocks fall much more at all over the next week or two, it’s going to raise a significant warning flag on this all-important group,” Matt Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak + Co., wrote in a note to clients Tuesday.
